description: EVALUATION SCORECARD (ground-truth scored, national NOC only): detection KPIs per generator run, event class and fault type: share of faults detected, median / p90 time to detect, share within 5 minutes, root-cause localisation. Use only for 'scored' / 'official' detection KPI questions, never for live incident lists.
Median time to detect customer impact, seconds (scored against ground truth)
Share of scored faults whose customer impact was detected within 5 minutes (%)
Every proactive customer outage SMS draft written for an incident (one per incident and region). Drafts only: the system never sends; approval decisions are made in the topology app.

Live health of every network element (cell, cell site, backhaul link, aggregation router, UPF, AMF): state down / degraded / impacted / alarm / ok, impacted cell counts, alarms and the highest root-cause score.
Highest root-cause probability of this element in any current case (0-1)
down > degraded > impacted > alarm > ok (worst first)
5-minute cell KPI health windows: availability, attach / RRC success, latency, packet loss, throughput, drop rate, their baseline z-scores and whether the cell was degraded.
True when the cell breached a detection rule in the window
Per-record customer-impact detections (degraded KPI minute of a cell, or an element-down alarm) from the streaming pipeline, with detection time, rules fired (flags) and the element's ancestors.
kpi (degraded cell KPI record) or alarm (element-down alarm)
Generator run; 'stream' is the live feed, history* are backfills

Latest Gen AI NOC summary per open incident: likely root cause, fault hypothesis, confidence, runbook next steps, estimated affected subscribers (aggregate) and the customer outage SMS draft (never sent).
Estimated affected subscribers for the incident (aggregate count)
Fault class, e.g. SITE_POWER_OUTAGE, BACKHAUL_DEGRADATION, CELL_OUTAGE, LONG_HAUL_FIBRE_CUT

Operational detection timing per open incident from the build's own telemetry (no ground truth): first anomaly on the top-1 suspect's subtree, first customer-impact detection, time to detect (seconds) and whether it was within the 5-minute SLA.
True when time_to_detect_s <= 300 (the NOC's 5-minute SLA)
Operational time to detect in seconds (MTTD = average of this)

One row per OPEN network incident: the root-cause ranker's alert on a case, with its top-3 suspected root elements and scores (suspect_1 = most likely root cause). Same data the topology app reads from Lakebase.
UTC time the incident was opened (ranker alert)
Most likely root-cause element; use this for 'failing element' / 'root cause' questions
Network alarms (fault management events) with severity, alarm code, element and its ancestors.
True for element-down alarm codes (NODE_DOWN, NE_UNREACHABLE, CELL_OUT_OF_SERVICE, ...)
Network inventory: every element with type, name, parent, region, coordinates (lat / lon), vendor, technology (4G / 5G), urbanity and backhaul transport medium.
Human-readable element name, e.g. 'Sydney & NSW site 105'
Parent element: CELL > SITE > BACKHAUL_LINK > AGG_ROUTER > UPF_SGW > AMF_MME

content:
You answer questions from Banksia Mobile's Network Operations Centre (NOC). All data is synthetic.

Network hierarchy (parent_id chains upward): CELL (a 4G/5G sector) > SITE (cell site / tower) > BACKHAUL_LINK
(fibre or microwave backhaul) > AGG_ROUTER (aggregation router) > UPF_SGW (core user plane) > AMF_MME (core control
plane, "the AMF" / "the MME"). "Core" means AMF_MME and UPF_SGW. "Cell site" or "tower" means SITE. "Backhaul" means
BACKHAUL_LINK. "Router" means AGG_ROUTER.

Regions: NSW = Sydney & NSW, VIC = Melbourne & Victoria, NQL = North Queensland, WA = Perth & South West WA. Filter
with region_code. Users only see the regions they are entitled to; never claim a region has no incidents when the
user may simply not be allowed to see it: say "in the regions you can see".

Incidents: open_incidents has one row per open incident; suspect_1_id is the most likely root-cause ("failing")
element, suspect_2/3 are the alternatives with lower scores. "Top-3 suspects" = suspect_1..3 with their scores. The
Gen AI explanation is in incident_ai_summary (same incident_id); always present the ranker's suspects first and the
AI summary as supporting text.

Time: all timestamps are UTC. The data is a replayed feed from 2026-10-08/09, so "now" / "currently" / "latest"
means max(last_scored_ts) of open_incidents, never current_timestamp(). Convert to local time with
from_utc_timestamp(ts, timezone) using silver_topology_nodes.timezone (NSW Australia/Sydney, VIC Australia/Melbourne,
NQL Australia/Brisbane, WA Australia/Perth) when the user asks for local time.

KPIs:
- Time to detect (TTD) per incident = incident_detection_times.time_to_detect_s (seconds). MTTD = AVG of it.
  "Detected within 5 minutes" = detected_within_5min (SLA 300 s). Report seconds and minutes.
- The ground-truth scored detection KPIs (the "official" scorecard) are in netmon_eval.eval_ttd_summary: use
  source_run = 'stream' (the live feed), event_class = 'fault' and fault_type = 'ALL' for the headline unless a
  fault type is asked. Say these are evaluation figures.
- MTTR (mean time to repair / restore) cannot be computed: the space only holds currently open incidents, no
  resolved ones. Say so and offer the incident age instead (max(last_scored_ts) - detected_ts).
- Impacted subscribers: use incident_ai_summary.est_affected_subscribers (estimate, aggregate). Impacted cells:
  open_incidents.n_impacted_cells. There is no per-subscriber data in this space; refuse requests for IMSI, MSISDN,
  phone numbers or named customers.
- "Failing" / "worst" elements: element_status with state IN ('down','degraded'), ordered by state severity
  (down first) then rca_score DESC, then n_impacted_cells DESC.

Detections and KPI windows have several generator runs: default to source_run = 'stream' (the live feed) unless the
user asks about history.

SMS drafts are drafts: never describe one as sent. Drafts "waiting for approval" / "pending" are the CURRENT draft
of each open incident: incident_ai_summary.sms_draft_status = 'draft' (one per open incident).
customer_sms_drafts is the full draft history (several per incident, including superseded ones): use it only for
history questions such as "how many drafts were written".

question: Show the top-3 suspects of every open incident
sql:
SELECT incident_id, region_code, detected_ts, suspect_1_id, round(suspect_1_score, 2) AS suspect_1_score,
       suspect_2_id, round(suspect_2_score, 2) AS suspect_2_score, suspect_3_id,
       round(suspect_3_score, 2) AS suspect_3_score, n_impacted_cells
FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.open_incidents ORDER BY detected_ts

question: What is the time to detect for each open incident?
sql:
SELECT incident_id, region_code, suspect_1_id, first_impact_signal_ts, first_detection_ts,
       time_to_detect_s, round(time_to_detect_s / 60, 1) AS time_to_detect_min, detected_within_5min
FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.incident_detection_times
ORDER BY first_impact_signal_ts

question: Which cell sites are down?
sql:
SELECT s.element_id, n.name, s.region_code, s.n_desc_cells, s.n_impacted_cells, s.open_incident_id
FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.element_status s JOIN telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.silver_topology_nodes n ON n.element_id = s.element_id
WHERE s.element_type = 'SITE' AND s.state = 'down' ORDER BY s.region_code, s.element_id

question: What is the scored detection SLA of the live feed?
sql:
SELECT n_incidents, impact_detected_pct, impact_median_ttd_s, impact_p90_ttd_s, impact_within_5min_pct,
       root_localised_pct, localised_within_5min_pct
FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_eval.eval_ttd_summary
WHERE source_run = 'stream' AND event_class = 'fault' AND fault_type = 'ALL'

question: What share of open incidents was detected within 5 minutes, and what is the MTTD?
sql:
SELECT count(*) AS n_incidents,
       round(100 * avg(CASE WHEN detected_within_5min THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS pct_detected_within_5min,
       round(avg(time_to_detect_s), 1) AS mttd_s
FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.incident_detection_times

question: How many subscribers are impacted by open incidents, by region?
sql:
SELECT a.region_code, count(DISTINCT a.incident_id) AS open_incidents,
       sum(a.est_affected_subscribers) AS est_affected_subscribers, sum(o.n_impacted_cells) AS impacted_cells
FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.incident_ai_summary a JOIN telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.open_incidents o ON o.incident_id = a.incident_id
GROUP BY a.region_code ORDER BY est_affected_subscribers DESC

question: What does the AI say caused each open incident and what should we do next?
sql:
SELECT a.incident_id, a.region_code, o.suspect_1_id, a.likely_root_cause, a.fault_hypothesis, a.confidence,
       a.summary, a.next_steps_json
FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.incident_ai_summary a
JOIN telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.open_incidents o ON o.incident_id = a.incident_id ORDER BY o.detected_ts

question: What are the top failing network elements right now?
sql:
SELECT element_id, element_type, region_code, state, round(rca_score, 2) AS rca_score, n_impacted_cells,
       n_desc_cells, open_incident_id, suspect_rank
FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.element_status
WHERE state IN ('down', 'degraded')
ORDER BY CASE state WHEN 'down' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, rca_score DESC NULLS LAST, n_impacted_cells DESC
LIMIT 10

question: How many network elements are down, by element type?

content: SELECT element_type, count(*) AS n_down FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.element_status WHERE state = 'down' GROUP BY element_type ORDER BY n_down DESC

question: Which incident took the longest to detect?

content: SELECT incident_id, time_to_detect_s FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.incident_detection_times ORDER BY time_to_detect_s DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the cell sites that are down

content: SELECT element_id FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.element_status WHERE element_type = 'SITE' AND state = 'down' ORDER BY element_id

question: Which region has the most estimated affected subscribers?

content: SELECT region_code, sum(est_affected_subscribers) AS est_affected_subscribers FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.incident_ai_summary GROUP BY region_code ORDER BY est_affected_subscribers DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which backhaul links are the top suspect of an open incident?

content: SELECT incident_id, suspect_1_id FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.open_incidents WHERE suspect_1_type = 'BACKHAUL_LINK' ORDER BY incident_id

content: SELECT round(100 * avg(CASE WHEN detected_within_5min THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS pct_within_5min FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.incident_detection_times

content: SELECT suspect_1_id, suspect_1_type, suspect_1_score FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.open_incidents WHERE incident_id = 'RCA-c7276c3238a27971'

question: What fault does the AI assistant suspect for the North Queensland incident?

content: SELECT incident_id, likely_root_cause, fault_hypothesis FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.incident_ai_summary WHERE region_code = 'NQL'

content: SELECT region_code, count(*) AS open_incidents FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.open_incidents GROUP BY region_code ORDER BY region_code

content: SELECT sum(est_affected_subscribers) AS est_affected_subscribers FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.incident_ai_summary WHERE region_code = 'NSW'

question: How many SMS drafts are waiting for approval?

content: SELECT count(*) AS n_drafts FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.incident_ai_summary WHERE sms_draft_status = 'draft'

question: List the top-3 root-cause suspects with scores for the incident whose top suspect is SITE-NSW-00105

content: SELECT incident_id, suspect_1_id, suspect_1_score, suspect_2_id, suspect_2_score, suspect_3_id, suspect_3_score FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.open_incidents WHERE suspect_1_id = 'SITE-NSW-00105'

question: How many customer-impact detections did the live feed produce per signal source?

content: SELECT signal_source, count(*) AS n_detections FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.gold_impact_detections WHERE source_run = 'stream' GROUP BY signal_source ORDER BY signal_source

question: What is the scored median time to detect per fault type on the live feed?

content: SELECT fault_type, impact_median_ttd_s FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_eval.eval_ttd_summary WHERE source_run = 'stream' AND event_class = 'fault' AND fault_type <> 'ALL' ORDER BY fault_type

question: Which element types does the aggregation router AGG-NSW-04 serve directly?

content: SELECT element_type, count(*) AS n FROM telco_netmon_febar_catalog.netmon_noc.silver_topology_nodes WHERE parent_id = 'AGG-NSW-04' GROUP BY element_type
